description: A test class for validating copy and replication semantics in a database-backed asset management system. Contains comprehensive integration tests for copying assets along with their related input parameters, source mappings, throughput equations, scalars, and data input values, ensuring proper duplication and integrity preservation.

classes.name: DbBackedCopyReplicationCorrectnessTests
classes.description: A suite of integrated tests verifying the correctness of copying assets and their nested related entities, ensuring proper duplication, lineage tracking, and source data preservation in a database-backed asset management system.

methods.name: Copy_asset_replicates_input_subtree_with_new_ids_and_preserves_source
methods.description: Main test method that performs the copy operation of an asset with nested entities, then verifies that the target's new entities are correctly created with new IDs, linked via lineage, and that the source remains unchanged.
